name: claude-code
description: Anthropic's Claude Code CLI (@anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.310), run headless (claude -p --output-format stream-json --include-partial-messages) with permissions skipped inside the sandbox, on any Anthropic Messages-shaped provider (the default is DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible endpoint with deepseek-flash). The request's input becomes the prompt, instructions are appended to the system prompt, reasoning.effort, text.format json_schema, MCP tools and max_tool_calls map to the CLI's own flags, and turns after the first resume the CLI's session. Assistant text streams token by token; thinking becomes reasoning items, Bash runs become shell_call items, Write/Edit/MultiEdit become apply_patch_call items, MCP tools become mcp_call items and every other tool a function_call, each with its output; token usage is reported on the final response.
